editorial:
Picture a bright kingdom where the kids of famous villains get a second chance, and you are along for a colorful ride. Ben, the kind son of King Adam and Queen Belle, invites Carlos, Mal, Evie, and Jay to leave their rough island home and attend a fancy school. The story mixes magic, music, and teen drama, so you get a fun blend of danger and heart. The costumes pop, the songs are catchy, and the world feels playful without being too heavy. You can tell the movie wants families to smile, laugh, and root for these misfit kids as they learn who they really are.

The cast brings plenty of energy, especially the villain kids, and the pacing keeps things moving with jokes, chases, and big musical moments. It is not perfect: some jokes feel silly, and the plot can be predictable. Still, if you enjoy Disney nostalgia, light adventure, and family-friendly fun, this is a great pick. Watch it streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for movie night.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Mal and the others face pressure to steal the wand and free Maleficent, but they choose friendship over evil. Maleficent turns into a dragon and attacks, yet the kids use teamwork and magic to stop her. She shrinks into a tiny lizard, and the villain kids decide to stay good. You see them celebrate at school, proving redemption can stick when you have real friends.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves Disney nostalgia, musical fun, and light family adventure.
